auto_use.title: Use pragmatic-engineer automatically
auto_use.description: Tell every Claude session and ~/.codex/AGENTS.md to use pragmatic-engineer for planning and coding. Off: call it yourself with /darrenxhays:pragmatic-engineer. A project can override this for its Claude sessions with PRAGMATIC_ENGINEER_AUTO_USE in its settings env (helm's CONFIG panel sets it). Takes effect in new sessions.
